label: Kitchen equipment (gas)
description: Generic gas kitchen equipment. Enter annual gas energy use to compute tCO2e/year using the portfolio gas emissions factor.

inputs.label: Annual gas energy use
inputs.help: Enter the estimated annual gas energy use for this equipment (or group of equipment).

inputs.label: Gas emissions factor
inputs.help: Emissions factor used to convert kWh into emissions. If the portfolio has a default for this, it will be used instead.
